note: Records of the packages added to cinatra.systemExtensions of the root package.json (cinatra#3832). A new package passes in the pull request that carries it, with its record here in the same change: { list: "system-extensions", row (the package's name), reason (a sentence of at least six words of three letters or more, at least four of them different), pr (the pull request's number) }. A record is carried forward unchanged while its package stands and goes when its package goes; a record without its package fails the gate.
